intentEvidence: Visualize your note activity with a GitHub-style heatmap.
problem: Existing contribution graphs often map one entry to one date, failing to track activity across multiple days when a single note is edited multiple times.

relations.evidence: Required for Git Diff features. Without it, the heatmap still works; only diff viewing is unavailable.
If installed, diff views open in its UI for a richer experience with automatic commit selection.

summary: Note Heatmap visualizes note activity using a GitHub-style heatmap, allowing users to track writing habits and discover patterns across daily, monthly, and yearly views.
